## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-5-5`, cutoff 2026-06-30) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [guide] = the package's upgrade guide, [summary] = summary of both.

**typescript** 6.0.3 → 7.0.2 (major)
- `CompilerOptions` options removed: `allowSyntheticDefaultImports`, `alwaysStrict`, `baseUrl`, `charset`, `downlevelIteration`, `importsNotUsedAsValues`, `keyofStringsOnly`, `noStrictGenericChecks` (+7 more). [types]
- `CompilerOptions` moved to `typescript/unstable/sync` [types]

**firebase** 12.14.0 → 13.0.0 (major)
- `getGenerativeModel()`: the `ai` argument no longer accepts `location` (in `firebase/ai`) [types]
  Before: `const ai = getAI(app, { backend: new VertexAIBackend('us-central1') });` → After: `const ai = getAI(app, { backend: new AgentPlatformBackend('us-central1') });` (type-checked)
- `new GenerativeModel()`: the `ai` argument no longer accepts `location` (in `firebase/ai`) [types]
  Before: `const model = new GenerativeModel({ ...ai, location: 'us-central1' }, { model: modelName });` → After: `const model = new GenerativeModel(ai, { model: 'gemini-3.5-flash-lite' });` (type-checked)
- Also removed: `getImagenModel`, `getTemplateImagenModel`, `ChatSessionBase`, `ImagenAspectRatio`, `ImagenGCSImage`, `ImagenGenerationConfig`, `ImagenGenerationResponse`, `ImagenImageFormat`, `ImagenInlineImage`, `ImagenModel` (+6 more). [types]
